transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint identity lookup tools.

Use **`POST /v3/search`** — the ISC Search API. You target the `identities` index and filter on the attribute you care about.

---

## Find an identity by email

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "attributes.email:\"jane.doe@example.com\""
  }
}
```

The `query.query` field is a Lucene expression. `attributes.email` is the standard identity attribute path; swap in whatever attribute name you need (e.g. `attributes.employeeNumber`, `name`, `displayName`).

---

### Tighter alternative — exact-match filter

If you want a precise, case-insensitive exact match (no tokenization side-effects), use `queryType: SAILPOINT` with a `term` filter instead of a free-text query:

```json
{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "*"
  },
  "queryType": "SAILPOINT",
  "filters": {
    "attributes.email": {
      "type": "TERM",
      "value": "jane.doe@example.com"
    }
  }
}
```

---

### curl one-liner

```bash
curl -s -X POST \
  "https://${TENANT}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "indices": ["identities"],
    "query": { "query": "attributes.email:\"jane.doe@example.com\"" }
  }'
```

---

### Key points

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| **Scope required** | `sp:search:read` |
| **`indices`** | Must be `["identities"]` to scope results to identities |
| **Attribute path** | `attributes.<attributeName>` for custom/standard attributes; `name`/`displayName`/`email` also work at the top level in Lucene |
| **Pagination** | Add `limit`/`offset` query params, or `searchAfter` for > 10 000 records |
| **Count** | Add `?count=true` to get `X-Total-Count` in the response header |

---

```answer-summary
    path: /v3/search
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [sp:search:read]

```
